# Reviewed under AGENTS.md
import re
from collections import Counter

_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z']+")


def top_words(text: str, k: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    """Return the ``k`` most common words in ``text`` as ``(word, count)`` pairs.

    Words are counted case-insensitively, a word being a maximal run of ASCII
    letters and apostrophes (so ``"don't"`` is one word and ``"well-known"``
    is two). Ties are broken alphabetically.
    """
    counts = Counter(
        word.lower() for word in _WORD_RE.findall(text) if any(char.isalpha() for char in word)
    )
    return sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:k]
